testcase.name: Scenario: Read and dismisses the direct panel selector help: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:708:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Read and dismisses the direct panel selector help ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ When the user opens the direct panel selector ✔ And the user closes it with the same selector control ✔ Then the Show Panels help tooltip appears ✔ And it explains that the down arrow displays more ribbon panels ✔ And it explains that selecting or clearing a checkbox adds or removes a panel ✔ And it offers additional help through F1 ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the tooltip closes ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon and part remain visible
